selection_reason: RSR-04 completed_verified after all 24 retained sources received explicit CEL/economy/life-loop decisions, 12 supplemental signals were recovered, 79 post-scarcity models were preserved as proposals, and exact-head RSR-01..04 plus canonical AIOC validation passed. RSR-05 is the strict successor.
objective: Execute RSR-05 — LSS Loot/Scavenge/Salvage Reconciliation. Audit all 24 retained sources for loot, item acquisition, rewards, salvage, scavenge, equipment recovery, creature/material recovery, decomposition/repair/cannibalization and related gameplay hooks; reconcile material against completed LSS-01..10 and existing Inventory/Asset, ICF and economy ownership. Reuse existing stable identities and rules where supported; preserve owner statements/corrections; keep assistant-generated loot tables, rewards, prices, component yields and salvage effects proposal-only; and route creature, supernatural, profession, world and final-coverage implications without creating a parallel inventory or loot ledger.
required_inputs: completed_verified RSR-03 ICF reconciliation for ingredient/material/creature-harvest boundaries
completed_verified RSR-04 routing for reward/acquisition/economy boundaries
completed_verified LSS-01..10 loot/scavenge/salvage foundations and current Inventory/Asset ownership
owner-authority rule: explicit owner statements/corrections outrank surrounding assistant-generated prose
completion_gate: All 24 retained sources receive an RSR-05 LSS relevance decision. Every material source is linked to existing LSS/Inventory/Asset/ICF authority, preserved as a noncanonical source-bound proposal, queued for conflict/uncertainty, or rerouted. No parallel loot/inventory ledger is created; unsupported drop tables, yields, prices, salvage values or creature outputs are not invented; downstream RSR-07/CCP/DPL/WCI/SGC routes are recorded; exact-head AIOC repository-health validation passes.
nonauthorization: RSR-05 implementation before a subsequent owner Continue governed-starts it
MSS-06 or later MSS implementation before completed_verified RSR-07
automatic canon promotion of assistant-generated loot tables, rewards, drop rates, component yields, salvage effects, item stats or prices
replacement of completed LSS or Inventory/Asset authority with parallel ledgers
silent stable-ID duplication or conflict normalization
next_action: On the next owner Continue, governed-start RSR-05 only from current AIOC main and execute the full LSS Loot/Scavenge/Salvage reconciliation through exact-head validation, merge and completed_verified closeout; then select RSR-06.
